runtime_dependencies.name: @sudocode-ai/cli
runtime_dependencies.reason: Sudocode 0.2.0 resolves better-sqlite3 11.10.0, whose Statement destructor calls node::RemoveEnvironmentCleanupHook after the environment is gone. On Node 24.21.0 the tracker initializes, then the process aborts on that assertion. Reprobed on a GitHub runner on 2026-09-09 and still reproducing: an isolated `sudocode init` exits 0, the full setup does not. Node 24 stays outside the contract until the tracker publishes a compatible dependency.

remediations.reason: @nestjs/platform-express pins multer 2.2.0 exactly, in Nest 11 as in Nest 12. Four high-severity denial-of-service advisories apply to <=2.2.0 and are fixed in 2.3.0, same major. The audit gate is not weakened: the vulnerable release is replaced by its corrected one.

The Nest 12 scaffold ships the `nest deploy` helper. Its inquirer -> external-editor -> tmp chain carries two high-severity advisories for which no fixed release exists, so no override can repair it. Build, lint, unit tests, end-to-end tests and the running application do not depend on it.

observations.reason: better-sqlite3 11.10.0 aborts on environment cleanup after a successful tracker initialization. Reproduced in CI on 2026-09-09; see VALIDATION.md.
Node 22.23.2 ships npm 10.9.8, below the 11.19.0 every supported case requires. Any job running adapter code must provision the declared manager, as the supported matrix already does.

observations.toolchain: Nest 11 or Nest 12 official scaffold, unremediated
observations.reason: Both fail `npm audit --audit-level high` on multer 2.2.0. The declared remediations are required, not optional.
